decisions.reason: Although its website prominence fell from a dedicated page to a mention, it is still in the core upholstery range and prior launch investment makes management more likely to continue it than withdraw quickly.
As a decorative fabric close to the established offer, it fits the firm's broad collection logic and can be retained while any weaker traction is interpreted as normal collection-cycle variation.
Its continued dedicated-page presentation, functional flame-retardant positioning, and clear fit with contract interiors create strong justification to keep it on the market.

This product builds directly on the firm's existing decorative textile competence, and with sunk development and merchandising effort management is likely to persist unless performance clearly collapses.
Its wool-based, semi-transparent design aligns with the firm's design-led and more sustainable direction, supporting continued commitment despite only moderate website emphasis.
As the newest launch with its own page and a close link to the established upholstery-and-curtain business, it is the least likely to be withdrawn so soon after introduction.
